newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Superior Metal expects better '97 results.
newsitem.headline: Superior Metal expects better '97 results.

text.p: Superior Metal Printing Ltd said on Wednesday it expects to do better this year.
It said in a statement that barring unforseen circumstances the board of directors expected attributable net pre-tax profit to be better than 1996.
The outlook of core business metal pails and cans and flexible packaging continued to be strong, it said.
Its subsidiary, Beijing Huade Metal Packaging Container Co Ltd was expected to contribute significantly and results of two other China units are also expected to improve, the statement said.
